hero.lead: Every set you lift, weighed against the one before it.

how.title: From nothing to competing with yourself
how.lead: Four steps. No blank page, no setup ritual, no spreadsheet.

steps.title: Pick or create an exercise
steps.body: Choose from our predefined catalogue, sorted by muscle group — or create your own in seconds.

steps.title: Build it into a routine
steps.body: Order sets and rest times — or start from one of our predefined routines and make it yours.

steps.title: Schedule it, or start right now
steps.body: Put it on the calendar with a reminder, or begin training this second.

steps.title: Next time, compete with yourself
steps.body: Your last session appears projected over the current one. That is Ghost Mode.

how.shortcut: Or use one of our predefined packs.

ghostPreview.sr: Previous session: 40 kilograms for 12 reps. Today: 82.5 kilograms for 8 reps.

ghost.title: Never wonder how much you lifted last time
ghost.body: TraceIron projects the data from your last completed session directly over the set you are working on. The number to beat is already on screen — you do not have to remember it, look it up, or trust it to a notebook.

demo.disclaimer: * Visual representation of the actual iOS app experience.
demo.srText: Ghost Mode demonstration on Bench Press projecting previous set records of 40 kg × 12 reps, 50 kg × 12 reps, and beating the record with 52.5 kg × 12 reps.

pairs.pain: I don't know if I'm actually progressing or just repeating the same session.
pairs.solution: Your previous numbers sit on top of the current set, and estimated one-rep max is computed from your real history. Progress stops being a feeling.

pairs.pain: Logging sets on my phone between rests pulls me out of the workout.
pairs.solution: Confirm a set with one thumb and feel it land. Or don't touch the phone at all: check in from Apple Watch, the Dynamic Island, or a Lock Screen widget.

pairs.pain: My data is held hostage by an app that charges for everything.
pairs.solution: Unlimited workout and set logging on the free plan, synced through your own private iCloud. Premium adds export to JSON, CSV and Excel.

items.q: Do I need to pay to use TraceIron?
items.a: No. You can log workouts and sets without limit, with Ghost Mode, Apple Watch, Live Activities and iCloud sync, for free. The free plan allows up to 3 routines; Premium makes them unlimited.
Yes. TraceIron is offline-first: everything is saved on the device, and iCloud syncs when there is a connection.
On your device and in your own private iCloud. TraceIron has no server of its own and does not access your workouts.
Yes, as JSON, CSV and Excel. Export is part of Premium.

items.q: Do I need an Apple Watch?
items.a: No. It is optional, and there is no additional cost if you already own one.

items.q: Can I share a routine with someone who doesn't have the app?
items.a: Yes. They get a web preview with the full content, and can import it for free once they install the app.
Monthly and annual renew automatically and you can cancel them whenever you want. Lifetime is a one-time payment that does not expire.

items.q: Is there an Android or web version?
items.a: No. TraceIron is exclusively native to the Apple ecosystem; that is a product decision, not a temporary limitation.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.lead: TraceIron has no server of its own. Your workouts live on your device and in your own private iCloud.

sections.title: 1. Data we handle
body: Data you enter yourself: routine and exercise names, sets, weight, reps, rest times, and notes.
Health data via HealthKit, only if you grant permission: the duration and intensity of your workout sessions, which TraceIron records in Apple's Health app.
Technical identifiers generated on your own device (UUIDs) to relate your routines, exercises, and sets to one another. They are not tied to your real name or to any advertising identifier.
We do not collect third-party analytics, do not show ads, and do not sell or share your data with anyone.

sections.title: 2. Where it is stored
body: Locally, on your iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch, via SwiftData.

In your own private iCloud, through automatic sync with CloudKit tied to your own Apple ID. Apple encrypts that data in transit and at rest; TraceIron has no access to it and keeps no parallel copy on any server of our own.
TraceIron does not operate any server or centralized database under our control, except for the specific case described in section 4 (Shared content).

sections.title: 3. HealthKit
body: If you grant permission, TraceIron records your workout sessions in the Health app so they show up alongside the rest of your physical activity.
We never sell or share health data with advertisers, data brokers, or any other third party, in line with Apple's HealthKit policies.
You can revoke this permission at any time from Settings → Privacy & Security → Health → TraceIron. The app keeps working without it; it simply stops recording your sessions in Health.

sections.title: 4. Shared content
body: When you use the share feature (swipe-to-share, or batch export), TraceIron uploads a copy of that routine or exercise to Apple's public CloudKit database, generating a short link (e.g. traceiron.com/r/abc123).

That content is accessible to anyone who receives the link, not only to the person importing it; it is not indexed by search engines, but it is not private either. Avoid putting personal or sensitive information in a routine's or exercise's name or notes before sharing it.
Sharing is always an explicit action on your part (never automatic), and anyone importing a link sees nothing about your identity beyond the content you chose to share.
You can ask us to remove already-shared content by writing to the contact address in section 7.

sections.title: 5. Purchases and subscriptions
body: All payments (monthly or annual Premium subscription, one-time Lifetime purchase, and individual themes such as Toxic or Founder) are processed entirely through Apple via StoreKit 2 and the App Store.
TraceIron never sees, receives, or stores your card or payment details. We only check your purchase status (entitlement) to unlock the corresponding features.
Cancellations, refunds, and subscription management happen directly with Apple, from Settings → [your name] → Subscriptions on your device.

sections.title: 6. Your rights
body: In line with Law No. 29733 (Peru's Personal Data Protection Law) and equivalent principles in other jurisdictions, you have the right to access, rectify, cancel, and object to the processing of your data.

Since your data lives on your device and in your own iCloud, you have direct control over nearly all of it: deleting the app removes local data, and you can manage or delete your iCloud data from your Apple account settings.
For content you've already uploaded to the public CloudKit database by sharing it (section 4), or for any other request about your data, contact us using the address in section 7.

sections.title: 7. Contact
body: For any question about this Privacy Policy or about your data, write to support@traceiron.com. We reply personally, since TraceIron is built by a single developer.

body: By downloading, installing, or using TraceIron you accept these terms. If you disagree with any of them, you should not use the app.

TraceIron is intended for a general audience and is not specifically directed at children under 13. If you are a minor under the laws of your country of residence, you need the consent of a parent or legal guardian to use it.

sections.title: 2. Licence to use
body: We grant you a personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable, revocable licence to use TraceIron on Apple devices you own or control, subject to Apple's standard App Store Usage Rules.
You may not reverse-engineer, redistribute, resell, or sublicense the app or any part of its code.

sections.title: 3. Subscriptions and one-time purchases
body: TraceIron offers a Premium subscription (monthly or annual, the latter with a 7-day free trial) and a one-time Lifetime purchase, plus individual visual themes (Toxic, Founder) as one-time purchases.
The price, duration, and exact terms of each plan are shown in the app before you confirm a purchase, and are always managed through StoreKit 2 / the App Store.

sections.title: 4. Renewal and cancellation
body: Monthly and annual subscriptions renew automatically at the end of each period, unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the current period ends.
The annual plan's free trial converts automatically into a paid subscription at the end of the trial, unless cancelled beforehand.
You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time from Settings → [your name] → Subscriptions on your Apple device.

sections.title: 5. Shared content
body: You are solely responsible for the content you choose to share (routine and exercise names, and any associated notes). By sharing, you acknowledge that content becomes accessible via a public link to anyone who receives it.
You must not share content that infringes on the rights of others, contains sensitive information about another person, or is offensive, unlawful, or misleading.

sections.title: 6. Health disclaimer
body: TraceIron is a workout tracking tool, not a medical service or a substitute for professional health advice.

Consult a physician before starting any exercise program, especially if you have a pre-existing condition. 1RM estimates and Ghost Mode projections are informational and do not replace supervision by a qualified professional.
You use the app and the information it provides at your own discretion and risk.

sections.title: 7. Limitation of liability
body: TraceIron is provided "as is" and "as available", without warranties of any kind. To the maximum extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect damages, data loss, or injuries resulting from use of the app or the information it contains.
Nothing in these terms limits any non-waivable rights you may have under the consumer protection laws of your country of residence.
